2608.14144.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
2608.14144.paper_summary: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. This asymmetry creates the same effective learning signal for free as a teacher with access to information unavailable to the student, without ground-truth annotations, rewards, or a separate stronger teacher model. Building on this principle, we introduce Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation (S$^2$VOPD), a simple yet effective method that constructs on-policy learning signals from asymmetric augmented views. S$^2$VOPD distills the teacher's distribution conditioned on the original image on-policy into the student distribution conditioned on a strongly augmented view of the same image. We systematically explore a broad design space of visual augmentations and uncover that (1) asymmetry matters: all four augmentation families improve performance, while symmetric self-distillation degrades it; (2) strength matters: performance peaks at a moderate strength; and (3) the gap must remain task-consistent: augmentations that completely remove the question-relevant evidence can induce large but uninformative discrepancies. Across six fine-grained perception benchmarks, S$^2$VOPD improves Qwen3.5-4B from 70.7% to 77.4%, above all open-source models compared, up to Qwen3-VL at 235B, and surpasses GPT-5.4. While holding training data the same, it recovers 96% of the improvement achieved by methods with privileged information. Website is at https://williamium3000.github.io/s2vopd
2608.14144.paper_summary_zh: 視覺上的政策蒸餾在很大程度上依賴於信息豐富的教師-學生不對稱，這可以通過更大、更強的教師或特權監督來實現，例如參考答案或真實的興趣區域。這引發了一個根本性問題：當沒有任何特權可用時，信息豐富的不對稱來自何處？我們通過反轉不對稱的來源來回答這個問題。我們不是向教師添加特權信息，而是從學生中減去信息。這種不對稱創造了與擁有學生無法獲得的信息的教師相同的有效學習信號，而不需要真實標註、獎勵或單獨的更強教師模型。在這一原則的基礎上，我們介紹了自監督視覺政策蒸餾（S$^2$VOPD），這是一種簡單而有效的方法，從不對稱增強視圖中構建政策學習信號。S$^2$VOPD將教師的分佈條件於原始圖像的政策蒸餾到條件於同一圖像的強增強視圖的學生分佈。我們系統地探索了廣泛的視覺增強設計空間，並發現（1）不對稱很重要：所有四種增強類別都提高了性能，而對稱自蒸餾則降低了性能；（2）強度很重要：性能在適中的強度下達到峰值；（3）差距必須保持任務一致性：完全去除問題相關證據的增強會產生大的但無信息的差異。在六個細粒度感知基準上，S$^2$VOPD將Qwen3.5-4B的性能從70.7%提高到77.4%，超過了所有比較的開源模型，甚至超過了235B的Qwen3-VL，並超越了GPT-5.4。在保持訓練數據不變的情況下，它恢復了通過擁有特權信息的方法所實現的96%的改進。網站地址為 https://williamium3000.github.io/s2vopd
